purpose: Four fixed demonstration outputs for print variation. Output size is read from each image by the existing generation workflow.

variants.name: 疏朗花枝
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: finished square botanical surface-pattern artwork for a fashion print-variation demo.
The provided image is the visual reference, not an output to copy exactly. Derive a beautiful new print from it. Preserve its authentic translucent watercolor brushwork, soft bleeding pigment, visible warm ivory watercolor paper, muted sage/olive leaves, burnt-sienna accents and delicate peach/coral wildflowers. Make genuinely new botanical silhouettes and a clearly different tasteful composition. Elegant designer textile quality, subtle natural irregularity, balanced negative space and fine details, not cheap clip art. Flat full-bleed 2D artwork, straight-on. Single square artwork, ideally 1536x1536 or higher. No text, logos, borders, collage, grid, garment mockup or photographic objects. No geometric overlays or simple recolor of the original.
Variant 1 — AIRY GARDEN. An open scattered arrangement of graceful curved stems with 3–5 airy peach cosmos-style blossoms, small coral flower sprays and slender sage leaves. Medium motif scale; ivory paper breathes between independent botanical sprigs. Long diagonal movements gently balance the square. Less dense than the source, delicate and refined with pale terracotta touches, distinctly fresh composition.
